gaps.sentence: Make sure you are fully ___ of the terms before you sign.
gaps.explanation: fully aware of something is the fixed collocation meaning knowing completely.

gaps.sentence: Her company ___ a huge profit last year.
gaps.explanation: make a profit (or make a loss) is the fixed business collocation.

gaps.sentence: She has ___ a diary since she was twelve.
gaps.explanation: keep a diary is the fixed collocation for writing in one regularly.

gaps.sentence: You are ___ a big risk if you invest all your money in one company.
gaps.explanation: take a risk means to do something that might have a bad result.

gaps.sentence: We ___ a taxi from the airport because it was raining.
gaps.explanation: take a taxi/bus/train is the standard collocation for using transport.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her a compliment on her new hairstyle.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody a compliment is the fixed collocation for praising someone.

gaps.sentence: The doctor has ___ detailed records of every patient since 1990.
gaps.explanation: keep records (of something) is the fixed collocation for storing information.

gaps.sentence: Students should ___ attention when the teacher is speaking.
gaps.explanation: pay attention is the fixed collocation for listening or concentrating carefully.
